svg.title: Intel brief preparation (intel-brief-v2 dependency graph)
svg.desc: A visit or Reload attaches to one durable chain per article generation; an active intel-brief-v1 chain is fenced and replaced by a new v2 generation. Two independent roots run together on the two-slot intel_brief drainer: Full article (local baseline, NLP keep-anchors, conditional Classifier batches) and Claims from the immutable metadata snapshot with Claim-assessor fidelity. Inferences is the fenced join: it binds once to both root task IDs and output hashes, in either commit order, then processes the clean body in ~12KB sentence-aligned chunks with up to three requests in flight, joins results in source order, checks fidelity and deduplicates exact repeats and paraphrases through bounded ID selection. Chunk failures or cancellation commit no partial result. Links follows Inferences. Each stage carries an immutable StageContext with the job generation and lease epoch. A failed root blocks only its descendants and Retry re-runs failed branches only. Per-node reuse adopts unchanged roots and descendants whose prerequisite hashes match. The fenced Links commit publishes the brief snapshot and leads, then calls the shared canonical publisher that the insight-refresh lease lane also uses, which writes Brain claims/inferences and tentative Related article leads, retires replaced leads and enqueues the index outbox atomically.

g.text: Publication v3: cached artifacts revalidate on visit;
tentative leads enter Brain; failures keep history.

svg.text: two slots · StageContext{generation, lease epoch} · failed root blocks only descendants · Retry re-runs failed branches
reuse: roots by node revision (Reload forces Body) · descendants by prerequisite hashes + revision · Links always re-reads
